# Code Anchors: Resumable Batch Filing

- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/run.ts` — the orchestrator: preflight ahead of config resolution, the three passes in order, the run counters, and the completeness decision that picks the exit code.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/preflight.ts` — the legality decision returning `ready | empty | refused`: the target-folder-inside-root test and the unplanned-plus-parent refusal, with no process exit anywhere in the library.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/preflight.spec.ts` — coverage for discovery, sorted order, the empty folder exiting zero, the out-of-root rejection, and the batch-wide refusal.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/ledger.ts` — the resume ledger: its file name, JSON shape, write-to-temporary-then-rename, and the tolerate-a-corrupt-file-as-empty rule.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/create.ts` — pass 1: files each item, sets its type, links its parent, and writes the ledger entry the moment the issue's identity resolves and before any decoration.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/create.spec.ts` — coverage for ledger-before-decoration ordering, ref reuse on a re-run, identity backfill, and the malformed-ledger warning.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/wire.ts` — pass 2: the one ref map built from this run plus every ledger entry, the batch-ref and literal-reference resolution rules, and the already-present edge count.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/rewrite.ts` — pass 3: rewrites surviving refs in bodies read back from the platform, writing only where the text differs.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/labels.ts` — establishes every label the run will apply before the first create, ending the run when one can neither be found nor created.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/projects.ts` — project targeting: explicit, auto-discovered or deliberately absent, with membership failures warned rather than fatal.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/retry.ts` — the transient-failure classifier and the retrying wrapper, applied to exactly the calls that carry it, with an injected clock so no test sleeps.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/platform.ts` — every platform call, each value an argument-vector element, bound to the resolved root through the injected process seam; each call now returns its outcome rather than printing.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/projects.ts` — the project lookups, generalised to return an outcome carrying the step that failed rather than printing, with the organization-then-user scope fallback unchanged.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/writeback.ts` — the settings write-back, its seeded-configuration line moved to the caller now that this layer prints nothing.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/report.ts` — the outcome summary, the incomplete marker, the ledger path, and the resume command rebuilt from the parsed arguments.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/frontmatter.ts` — the shallow line-oriented work-item reader, quirks preserved: bracket lists, a bare string read as a one-item list, and quote trimming.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/shared-module.spec.ts` — the structural assertion that the filer defines no equivalent of a shared capability and reaches each from the module that owns it.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/cutover.spec.ts` — asserts every recorded spawn is the platform client, mocking the process module one layer below the filer's own injected seam.
- `libs/gh-toolkit/nexus_gh/create_story.py` — the frozen predecessor, still on disk and still the behavioural specification until it retires.
- `libs/gh-toolkit/tests/test_backlog_stubs.py`, `libs/gh-toolkit/tests/test_deferred_scope_stubs.py`, `libs/gh-toolkit/tests/test_literal_dependency_refs.py`, `libs/gh-toolkit/tests/test_body_ref_rewrite.py` — the carried-across cases, kept green as parity evidence while both copies coexist.
- `components/skills/nxs-gh-create-story/SKILL.md` — the component body that invokes this path by capability name and reads its incomplete contract.
